top_choice_rationale: General ligand-controlled palladium-catalysed C-N cross-coupling is a mature, widely adopted enabling method with clean two-laureate allocation (Buchwald and Hartwig) and a well-bounded citation, and it has the broadest committee support. Targeted protein degradation is a conceptually strong induced-proximity principle but has no approved drug and a contested credit boundary (glue versus heterobifunctional lineages), so it ranks second; an award is preferable to no award.
